source: Add notification center, invoice view, responsive tables, breadcrumbs, and schedule generation feedback

assumptions.text: Use Compass Sheet with Tabs and Item for the notification center, Dialog for invoice details, and AlertDialog for schedule confirmation.
Notification read state is session-only because no notification service is connected; schedule generation uses a seven-second demo state within the requested five-to-ten-second range.
Notification messages, invoice billing details, schedule counts, affected lives, and premium impact are representative demo data.
Use the user-confirmed All, Alerts, and Updates tabs, bg-muted/50 table headers, and compact Item layouts for dense tables below wide desktop.
Map the attached breadcrumb layout to Compass gap-4, h-8 separator, and standard Button and Breadcrumb spacing.
